decisive_kills.reason: OmniRoute is an active MIT multi-provider AI gateway whose public product already advertises quota-aware auto-fallback, remaining-quota/reset-aware routing and maximizing subscription quota before expiry.

OmniRoute issue #13616 generalized provider-specific billing/quota endpoints into a common UsageQuota abstraction and was closed as completed on 2026-09-18; LiteLLM issue #31823 independently requests provider package/quota-pool routing. The proposed micro-edge is becoming ordinary gateway functionality.

The useful state comes from provider-owned quota APIs plus customer-owned credentials and workload metadata. No proprietary cross-customer outcome asset, exclusive right or transaction-generated acceptance graph is created by routing itself.

Current evidence proves expiring quota and management pain, but the direct LiteLLM request has minimal public support and no evidence was found that enterprises separately pay for quota-pool optimization rather than expect it inside an existing gateway/provider subscription.

Alibaba already prioritizes the nearest-expiring shared quota package internally, and current enterprise multi-model Token Plans aggregate multiple models/vendors into shared pools, reducing the residual cross-provider optimization surface.

evidence.title: OmniRoute
evidence.fact: Active MIT AI gateway with quota-aware auto-fallback and quota/reset-aware routing; current repository has tens of thousands of stars and forks.

evidence.title: OmniRoute issue #13616
evidence.fact: Generic billing/quota support for OpenAI-compatible connections was requested 2026-09-13 and closed completed 2026-09-18, normalizing arbitrary upstream quota APIs into common routing state.

evidence.title: LiteLLM issue #31823
evidence.fact: Provider quota pools/package-based routing remains an open feature request, but public support is sparse and it frames the capability as a router feature.

evidence.title: Alibaba Token Plan team overview
evidence.fact: When multiple shared packages exist, Alibaba prioritizes the package nearest expiry, showing expiry-aware entitlement consumption is naturally internalized by the provider.

evidence.title: Qiniu enterprise Token Plan comparison
evidence.fact: Current enterprise plans can already expose multiple vendors/models behind one shared prepaid pool, reducing the need for customers to independently optimize several provider subscriptions.
